name: Animated Tweet
description: A tweet card template that animates into view with realistic platform-accurate styling. Great for sharing social proof and user feedback in a more polished format.

name: Blast: Social Media Showcase
description: A high-energy social media showcase template with fast motion and strong pacing. Good for bold creative portfolios and brand content that needs to make a quick impression.

name: Design Preview
description: A design preview template from Vendredi Society that presents work inside an animated frame. Good for design handoff presentations and client-facing showcases.

name: Drop It Like It's Hot: Mask
description: A mask-based animation template from Savee with bold kinetic motion. Perfect for creative agency showreels and high-impact brand content.

name: Drop It Like It's Hot: Sizzle Reel
description: A fast-paced sizzle reel template made by Savee with energetic cuts and strong transitions. Great for agency showreels and creative portfolio content.

name: Folio: Social Media Showcase
description: A portfolio-format social media showcase template with elegant animated transitions. Good for creative professionals who want their social content to feel as considered as their work.

name: Frames: Mobile Showreel
description: A mobile showreel template that presents app screens inside device frames with animated transitions. Great for portfolio presentations and app store assets.

name: Image Carousel: Parallax
description: A carousel template where images move at slightly different speeds to create a parallax depth effect. Good for editorial slideshows and photo presentations that would feel flat with a standard transition.

name: Instagram Stories: Collage
description: A collage story template with multiple images animated in an overlapping layout. Works for mood boards and creative posts that want to feel assembled rather than designed.

name: Instagram Story: 2 Images
description: A story template with two images and clean animated transitions between them. Good for before/after content and dual product showcases.

name: Instagram Story: 2 Images With Captions
description: A story template with two images and animated text captions for each. Good for product descriptions and storytelling posts where the image and the words need to work together.

name: Instagram Story: 2 Square Images
description: A story template with two square images side by side and animated transitions. Good for comparison posts and paired product showcases.

name: Instagram Story: 2 Vertical Images
description: A story template with two vertical images and smooth animated transitions. Perfect for portrait photography and fashion editorial posts.

name: Instagram Story: 3 Horizontal Images
description: A story template with three horizontal images and animated reveals. Good for photo dumps and lifestyle content that wants a bit of structure.

name: Instagram Story: 3 Square Images
description: A story template with three square images in an animated layout. Good for product showcases and photo collages.

name: Instagram Story: 3D Hand
description: A story template featuring an animated 3D hand element. Good for product interaction demos and social content that wants a tactile feel.
